combinations.magnitude: MWT and TWL significantly reduced versus AAV si-S100A11 alone
combinations.evidence_quote: Pain behavioral results showed that, compared with the AAV si-S100A11 group, Mdivi-1 treated CCI mice exhibited significantly reduced MWT and TWL (Fig. S3A, B).

combinations.magnitude: Mdivi-1 attenuated LC3B and abrogated S100A11 knockdown effect
combinations.evidence_quote: However, administration of the mitophagy inhibitor Mdivi-1 significantly attenuated LC3B green fluorescence, inhibited mitophagic flux, and abrogated the effect of S100A11 knockdown (Fig. 7H, I).

combinations.magnitude: TFEB knockdown abrogated S100A11-knockdown enhancement of mitophagy
combinations.evidence_quote: This indicated that the S100A11 knockdown-induced enhancement of mitophagy was abrogated.

combinations.magnitude: A-485 decreased LC3/Parkin/Pink1 and increased P62
combinations.evidence_quote: Compared with the S100A11 knockdown group, A-485 administration decreased the expression of mitophagy-related proteins (LC3, Parkin, and Pink1) and increased P62 expression, abrogating the S100A11 knockdown-induced enhancement of mitophagy (Fig. 8T-X).
